budget.definition: uF=FLT_EPSILON/2,uD=DBL_EPSILON/2,Gamma(n,u)=n*u/(1-n*u); positive finite units per output channel, actual receiver neighbor count. No CPU absolute or half-step physical thresholds reused.
budget.packed: Per displacement component, Gamma(3,uF) plus Gamma(8,uD) times sum of absolute stored local operands and size*integer-difference, plus3*FLT_MIN. Squared radius propagates dr uncertainty and Gamma(5,uF) plus host reference arithmetic. Full-double displacement uses Gamma(2,uD), squared radius uses corresponding double count.
budget.kernel: Use analytic Wendland factor (bwen/h)*(1-r/(2h))^3; this is the real-number reference, not a claim that device code divides bwen/h. Actual device bwen*qq*w*w*w/rad has two fast divides (qq=rad/h, final/rad), budgeted at5uF each including final rounding, plus four products at uF each; 14uF before composition is contained in Gamma(16,uF). Shared rad correlation is not ignored by silently equating rounded qq/rad to1/h; separate explicit q/radius intervals remain. Propagate squared-radius and optional float-cast error through positive sqrt and q, then cubic product. Device sqrt1ULP+rounding and division2ULP+rounding assumptions enter these intervals; include small FTZ allowances. This remains a conditional published-envelope engineering screen, not a universal floating-point proof or a guarantee for all CUDA inputs.
budget.accumulation: Propagate pair bounds and absolute-term sums through FS moment, C products, corrected theta, raw float gradient reductions, six elastic rates, and complete Darcy lp/lx/gp/divAce. Final pressure/stress storage float cast included. Each Ratio<=1; failures retained without tuning bounds from results. Upper-edge union makes zero-center/nonzero-error pairs possible: reduction magnitudes therefore retain abs(pair_center)+pair_error; final Darcy major uses abs(sum_center)+sum_error for lp/da and both gp/lx factors, including their bilinear error, and gd*(major+le). The C-moment product reduction similarly uses max(1,cmag+ce). Gamma operation counts are unchanged. These are reference-side arithmetic closure repairs, not physical tolerances.
budget.source_math_scope: Official CUDA11.7 H.1 tables report fast division2ULP and fast sqrt1ULP for SM>=5.2, based on extensive but nonexhaustive tests, not guaranteed bounds. H.2 documents FMA contraction and fast-math intrinsic substitutions. Actual retained GPU logs show -use_fast_math and compute_86/sm_86. Fixture requires device SM>=5.2; no flags or kernels changed.
budget.upper_support_edge: Original analytic fac=(bwen/h)*(1-sqrt(rr)/(2h))^3 and ef remain. For upper-edge pair set g_ref=fr_ref=0; g_error=(abs(fac)+ef)*(abs(d)+de)*(1+Gamma(4,uD)), then retain original final-float cast allowance for fr_error. This encloses the union of omitted0 and included factor within the unchanged radius/q/factor interval; no new empirical constant/tolerance fit. Existing FS moment/theta/stress/Darcy/load propagation uses the bound. Gamma neighbor count includes possible pairs. A solely inner-theta edge uses zero reference plus abs(g)+ge. Counts and maximum bounded uncorrected gradient contribution are emitted per probe/sample and in total, not hidden.
budget.unchanged: No physical gate, Gamma operation count, original inside-pair/kernel uncertainty or production CUDA flag/kernel changed; no frozen r1 record changed. Upper-cutoff union and nonzero-error magnitude propagation repair reference definition, not physics accuracy or a blanket passed result.
